property_summary: For every caller address A, if A is not equal to c.owner() then calling transferOwnership(...) from A must NOT change c.owner(); the mutant (which removes the onlyOwner check) allows some non-owner caller to change owner, violating this rule.
change_summary: Remove the require check in onlyOwner so the modifier no longer enforces ownership (always allows), enabling anyone to call transferOwnership.
